description: FAKE signed PDFs for myCarlos's PDF verifier (carlos-emr/mycarlos#55), made by CARLOS's MyCarlosSignedPdfFixtures. Every key is FAKE. Fields ending _b64 are standard base64.

keys.derivation: key bytes = SHA-256(UTF-8 seed_text). P-256: scalar = int(key bytes, big-endian) mod (n - 1) + 1. As in carlos-portal tests/fixtures/delivery-contract.json.

signer.seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: clinic-a signing key 1

other_clinic.seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: clinic-b signing key 1

rsa_signer.note: A random RSA-2048 key, used only by refuse-rsa-signer.pdf.

documents.name: signed-send-to-mycarlos.pdf
documents.note: A Send to myCarlos copy: unencrypted, PAdES B-B, manifest in the signature's update.

documents.name: signed-email-encrypted.pdf
documents.note: The email path: AES-256 password-protected, then signed; the manifest is encrypted too.

documents.name: signed-no-manifest.pdf
documents.note: Signed by the clinic, but there is no manifest to match a person.

documents.name: signed-no-recipient.pdf
documents.note: recipient_id is null: the patient had no portal link.

documents.name: refuse-byte-flipped.pdf
documents.note: One byte inside the signed range changed (in the header comment, so the PDF still opens).

documents.name: refuse-extra-update.pdf
documents.note: A later incremental update changes the document information after the signature.

documents.name: refuse-incomplete-range.pdf
documents.note: Bytes follow the signed range, but no update.

documents.name: refuse-kid-mismatch.pdf
documents.note: Signed with clinic-a's key, but the manifest names clinic-b's key.

documents.name: refuse-rsa-signer.pdf
documents.note: Signed with an RSA key; the manifest's kid is that key's own ID.

documents.name: refuse-two-signatures.pdf
documents.note: The Send to myCarlos copy, signed a second time.

documents.name: refuse-extra-claim.pdf
documents.note: The manifest has one claim too many.
